scope: Current real-save and whole-page adjudication, followed by isolated unmerged snapshot proposal diagnostics.

adjudication.mathEvidence: 20 current full-state/envelope/actual macro/save Worker cases equal; proof uses frozen refs Cae/fde.
adjudication.naturalEvidence: 8 current fresh-browser runs, 64 complete OS points against accepted 8c54, independent ABBA per mode; all guards pass.
limits: Two trials per variant/mode; do not claim wider player/FPS gains.
Both peak distributions are disjoint and higher. Late 30/60-sec convergence does not pass transient-memory goal or prove absence of any long leak.
Replication baseline early tails are bimodal; do not advertise their median drop as stable improvement.
Function-level profiled belt-reservation attribution is directional, not whole-runtime acceptance.
Do not compare Cae prior-cohort peaks directly with fde current peaks to assign cause.
next: Prioritize common startup/handoff transient memory in BOTH modes.
Validate private scratch proposal only as snapshot-function parity; do not claim memory gains or that it covers replication.
Keep full original performance scope active.

profiledAttributionOnly.correction: v1 helper supplied 0 for an absent machinesMs alias. That field was not measured. This version includes only fields present in every actual bucket; v1 remains retained.

snapshotProposal.status: isolated snapshot proposal, not merged into runtime
snapshotProposal.scope: Four fixed captures of the real prepared state in each of two fresh serial Node diagnostic processes; actual extracted functions instrumented to count explicit array literal expressions only.
scopeLimits: Capture helper is used by lightweight/conservative calibration. Replication initialization returns through its own path; this proposal is not proof of fixing both modes.
The common checkpoint captures aggregate/resource/terminal baselines through other functions; common startup/handoff needs separate evidence.
Count reduction is not a percentage decrease in RSS, heap, total allocations, startup delay, or FPS.
A game-source adoption needs full proportional gates, fixed Worker/save proof, and new natural peak measurements.

snapshotSyntheticParity.scope: Extracted actual closed snapshot functions only; not full macro/game/Web qualification

baseline.scope: Instrumented explicit path-array-expression counts on real read-only prepared save, four captures/shared registry. Not total JS allocation, Web memory, latency or performance qualification.

prototype.scope: Instrumented explicit path-array-expression counts on real read-only prepared save, four captures/shared registry. Not total JS allocation, Web memory, latency or performance qualification.
